title: Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.19587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning the underlying probability distribution from samples is a core problem in statistics and applied mathematics. Generative models based on diffusion and flow matching learn a velocity field whose flow transports a known distribution to the data distribution. They produce novel, realistic samples, although the empirical learning problem is ill posed near the data distribution. Its minimizer transports the samples onto the training data, and small perturbations of the data change the velocity field strongly near the end of the flow. The observed generalization is often attributed to implicit regularization by the network parameterization, early stopping of the training, and the time integration during sampling. Explicit regularization has advanced the theory and computation of many inverse problems and has recently been proposed to prevent memorization in generative models. translated_abstract: 从样本中学习潜在的概率分布是统计学和应用数学中的核心问题。基于扩散和流匹配的生成模型学习一个速度场，其对应的流将一个已知分布传输至数据分布。尽管经验学习问题在数据分布附近是病态的，这些模型仍能产生新颖且逼真的样本。其极小化器会将样本传输到训练数据上，而数据的微小扰动会在流动的末端强烈地改变速度场。所观察到的泛化能力通常被归因于网络参数化带来的隐式正则化、训练的提前停止以及采样过程中的时间积分。显式正则化已在许多逆问题的理论与计算中取得进展，最近也被提出用于防止生成模型中的记忆化现象。而通过在速度幅值上施加正则化项……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在流匹配中对速度场（如速度幅值）施加显式正则化，以克服数据分布附近经验学习问题的病态性并防止模型记忆训练样本，从而提升生成模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces explicit regularization (e.g., on the magnitude of the velocity field) for flow matching, addressing the ill-posedness of the empirical learning problem near the data distribution and preventing memorization, thereby improving the generalization of generative models.
